notes: A conjecture is a `def` whose type is literally Prop; it asserts nothing and needs no sorry. Stating is nearly free while proving is hard, so the cheap act is tied to the expensive one: a producer may hold at most this many unresolved conjectures per accepted theorem they have landed. A producer with no accepted theorem may state none. Resolution is an accepted `theorem name : ConjectureName := ...`, the shape CONTRACT.md requires.
